hypothesis: A configured renewable necessity can sustain the settlement after all initial food has been exceeded, while matched disabled production exposes finite-stock failure.
evaluation: Roadmap Stage 1: compare twelve minutes with 22 total initial food, unchanged cold and Luna medium/15-second cadence. Renewable clearing produces at most 8 food/minute against approximately 5.486/minute four-person upkeep; control disables only production. Verify initial + produced = final + eaten, actual consumption beyond initial stock, at least a surviving small group, local perception, shared work, low-pressure sampled intervals and causes of death. Do not equate generated food or speech with society acceptance; repeat promising outcomes before Stage 1 completion.
